rules:
This is a classic puzzle game where you have to find the differences between two almost identical images.

	1. You will be asked to compare two images that appear to be very similar to each other.
	2. Use your finger, stylus or mouse to tap where you notice differences in the second image.
	3. If you have found the differences correctly, they will be marked with green circles and you will move on to the next pair of images.
	4. If you can't find all the differences, you can use the hints.

	Remember that the number of errors per level can be limited. Also keep in mind that not all differences are obvious - sometimes you have to look closely at the details to find them.
